titles.title: ワタシをかき乱すカレ

description:
"You don't kiss your sister"  
It was a photo posted on SNS that led Dojun to Korea for the first time in 10 years.  
The moment I saw her, in the picture imprinted on his head, she was his sister without a drop of blood.  
JeA called to the club to attend the new president's celebration party.  
Blinded by the prize money, she is drawn into the VVIP room by someone's hand to make a bet to take a picture of the president.  
In the pitch-black darkness, a familiar tap that penetrates the ear.  
"Talk, talk, talk, talk, talk, talk."  
It was a code that only he and she knew.  
Her heart, which was dead, starts beating subtly… (MTL)
